body: I glance around nervously, noticing faces in unfamiliar places staring at me. Panic starts to creep into my heart as I realize this must be happening all over again. My body tenses up, muscles straining against fear. I can't go back to sleep now; there's nothing comforting about feeling trapped in a situation like this.
full:
I glance around nervously, noticing faces in unfamiliar places staring at me. Panic starts to creep into my heart as I realize this must be happening all over again. My body tenses up, muscles straining against fear. I can't go back to sleep now; there's nothing comforting about feeling trapped in a situation like this. 

Next: put real distance between myself and it.
